creates_law_reviewed.class: INSTRUMENT -- a retrieval tool over our own surfaces; the results it recovers belong to the arcs that proved them
creates_law_reviewed.basis: read at banking: the product is the sweep, its triage, and three declined homonyms; it proves nothing new about the object

claim_one_line: CELL 0 OF THE PUBLICATION CAMPAIGN, THE REVERSE SWEEP (arcs -> surfaces), discharging R53-3's first half and GATING Cells 1-3. open_claim_sweep.py runs surfaces -> arcs and structurally CANNOT see a banked result that no surface mentions at all -- there is no claim to match. This asks of every settled arc whether any live surface carries it, on two signals (id citation, and high-IDF content coverage), off-surface only if BOTH fail. TWO OWN FAILURES, FIXED: (1) the first run returned ZERO against B1188's known 132 -- views/VERDICT_LEDGER (1180 arcs), THE_SPINE (979) and CLOSED_DOORS (528) are GENERATED per-arc enumerations in which every arc appears BY CONSTRUCTION, so counting them as surfaces makes the measurement zero by definition; B1218's own tautology rule, applied once and not carried over. (2) The positive control failed 0/5 and THE CONTROL WAS STALE, NOT THE INSTRUMENT: B1188's five sharpest off-surface arcs (B279/B769/B786/B293/B552) are all now cited in docs/GRAND_COMPUTATION_LEDGER.md -- which is B1188's OWN REMEDY. The control was testing a condition the corpus had repaired; that is the fix working. Concluded only after locating WHICH surface cites each of the five, not on plausibility -- 'the control must be wrong' is how a broken instrument gets waved through. (3) THE INSTRUMENT WAS NON-DETERMINISTIC AND THAT WAS CAUGHT BEFORE BANKING: two runs over the same tree gave 45 and 46, while six in-process calls were identical -- toks() returns a SET and the score truncates to the twelve highest-IDF terms, so on IDF ties WHICH twelve survive depends on set iteration order, randomized per process by PYTHONHASHSEED; fixed by breaking ties on the term itself, five separate processes now agreeing exactly. A verifier that does not reproduce is worthless -- E52's own class, caught by re-running rather than by care; the same latent tie-break was hardened in B1218, where it affected only displayed terms. REPLACED WITH PLANTED CONTROLS THAT CANNOT GO STALE (the form codex's R028 certificate uses): plant A, object-facing vocabulary occurring on no surface, MUST flag -> flagged at cover 0.42; plant B, text copied verbatim from a heavily-surfaced document, must NOT flag -> not flagged at cover 1.00; plus the standing negative that B1141/B1170 do not flag. Separation is real but THE 0.55 BAR IS A JUDGEMENT, not a derived constant. RESULT: 1032 settled arcs scanned, 45 OFF-SURFACE -- 29 SURFACE-IT, 10 INTERNAL, 6 SUPERSEDED. Against the pre-registered expectation (40-90, at least one bearing on Cells 1-3): 45, inside the range at its low end; far below B1188's 132 because much of that 132 was surfaced into GRAND_COMPUTATION_LEDGER as B1188's remedy and this sweep also clears arcs whose CONTENT is carried without the id -- 45 is the residue after the previous repair, not a contradiction of it. GATE VERDICT: CELLS 1-3 ARE NOT BLOCKED; no banked work changes their design. THREE HOMONYM TRAPS DECLINED, which is the arc's real product: B603's 'weight' is a Lie-algebra grading weight, NOT lambda's von Neumann weight; B26's 'lambda/h=1' is a Fibonacci trace-map ratio, NOT the type III_lambda modular parameter; B551's 'species word' (complexity ~3n) is NOT the chain's golden word (Sturmian, n+1). Any one taken on its name would have redirected a cell onto a different object. TWO FINDINGS SURFACED: B551 CORROBORATES the paper's new section 3 (no rotation/winding mechanism can emit the Q(sqrt-phi) layer, which REQUIRES substitutive inflation order -- exactly section 3's framing); B342 (the object's Z/3 is standard trimaximal, TM2 disfavoured) belongs on the value-negative record and must NEVER enter the paper, Gate 5 governing. Scope: lexical, over the named SURFACES only; it does not adjudicate; the remaining 26 are triaged, not adjudicated. Gate 5 clean.
